facts.name: Wild Ginger
facts.notes: A dense groundcover of soft, heart-shaped leaves for shade. The little maroon spring flowers hide at ground level under the leaves.
facts.toxSrc: Not culinary ginger; contains aristolochic acid (general references; not on the ASPCA list)
